faqs.question: What exactly is an AI receptionist?
faqs.answer: It's an AI employee that answers your business phone line — handling FAQs, booking appointments straight into your calendar, and logging every lead — so calls get answered even when your team is busy or after hours.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: There's a one-time setup fee, typically $300 to $1,000 depending on complexity, plus a monthly subscription that covers hosting, voice minutes, and support. Exact pricing depends on your business — share your email or fill out your business details at https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo and the team will follow up with an exact quote.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Most businesses are live within a week once we have your business details — hours, services, and FAQs, either shared directly or submitted at https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo.

faqs.question: Does it replace my staff?
faqs.answer: No — it handles the repetitive front-desk work like answering common questions and booking, so your team can focus on customers who are already in front of them.

faqs.question: Can it work with my existing calendar and CRM?
faqs.answer: Yes, it connects to Google Calendar for booking and can log leads to a sheet or CRM depending on your setup.

general: We no longer offer phone or video discovery calls. If a caller wants to move forward, ask for their email so the team can follow up personally, or share this link so they can submit their business details directly and get started: https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo
